Hint: Please answer the question requiring a floating-point number with two decimal places and provide the final value, e.g., 1.23, 1.34, 1.45, at the end.
Question: A p-type semiconductor with zero electric field is under illumination (low-level injection) in steady-state condition. Excess minority carrier density is zero at \( x = \pm 2l_n \), where \( l_n = 10^{-4} \, \text{cm} \) is the diffusion length of electrons. Assume electronic charge \( q = -1.6 \times 10^{-19} \, \text{C} \). The profiles of the photo-generation rate of carriers and the recombination rate of excess minority carriers (R) are shown. Under these conditions, the magnitude of the current density due to the photo-generated electrons at \( x = +2l_n \) is ________ mA/cm² (rounded off to two decimal places).

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The upper half of the attached figure shows the photogenerated carrier generation rate G(x): it is a rectangular plateau between x=-l_n and x=+l_n, with a value of 10^20 cm^-3 s^-1; it is 0 in the regions x<-l_n and x>+l_n, including being 0 from +l_n to +2l_n. The lower half shows the excess minority carrier recombination rate R(x): in the central region it changes according to R=10^20 exp(-|x|/l_n), symmetric about x=0; it is 0 in the interval from +l_n to +2l_n. Reasoning: The problem gives l_n=10^-4 cm and electron charge q=-1.6e-19 C, and asks for the magnitude of the photogenerated electron current density at x=+2l_n. Since G and R are symmetric about x=0, the electron current at the center is zero, namely J_n(0)=0. Under steady state and zero electric field, integrating the minority-electron continuity equation from x=0 to x=+2l_n, the electron flux flowing out of the right end equals the integral of the net generation rate in this half-region. In the figure, in the interval from +l_n to +2l_n, G=0 and R=0, so it is only necessary to integrate from 0 to l_n: net flux = integral_0^l_n [10^20 - 10^20 exp(-x/l_n)] dx = 10^20 [l_n - l_n(1-exp(-1))] = 10^20 l_n exp(-1). Substituting l_n=10^-4 cm: net flux = 10^16/e = 3.6788e15 cm^-2 s^-1. The magnitude of the current density is |q| times flux = 1.6e-19 * 3.6788e15 = 5.886e-4 A/cm^2 = 0.5886 mA/cm^2, rounded to 0.59 mA/cm^2.

method.method_draft: First describe the image profiles: identify G(x)=10^20 cm^-3 s^-1 only between -l_n and +l_n, and identify R(x)=10^20 exp(-|x|/l_n) in that same central interval, with both profiles zero from l_n to 2l_n on the right. From the text take l_n=10^-4 cm, q=-1.6×10^-19 C, steady state, zero electric field, and the boundary of interest x=+2l_n. Because the profiles are symmetric, set J_n(0)=0. Integrate the minority-electron continuity equation from x=0 to x=+2l_n. The interval l_n to 2l_n contributes zero net generation/recombination from the image, so the integral reduces to the area difference between the rectangle G and the exponential R over 0 to l_n. Multiply the resulting electron flux by |q| and express in mA/cm² to obtain about 0.59.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：附图上半部分显示光生载流子产生率 G(x)：在 x=-l_n 到 x=+l_n 之间为矩形平台，数值为 10^20 cm^-3 s^-1；在 x<-l_n 和 x>+l_n 区域为 0，包括从 +l_n 到 +2l_n 为 0。下半部分显示过剩少数载流子复合率 R(x)：在中心区域按 R=10^20 exp(-|x|/l_n) 变化，关于 x=0 对称；在 +l_n 到 +2l_n 区间为 0。

推理：题给 l_n=10^-4 cm，电子电荷 q=-1.6e-19 C，要求 x=+2l_n 处光生电子电流密度的大小。由于 G 和 R 关于 x=0 对称，中心处电子电流为零，即 J_n(0)=0。稳态、零电场下，对少数电子连续性方程从 x=0 积分到 x=+2l_n，右端流出的电子通量等于该半区的净产生率积分。图中 +l_n 到 +2l_n 区间 G=0 且 R=0，所以只需积分 0 到 l_n：
net flux = integral_0^l_n [10^20 - 10^20 exp(-x/l_n)] dx = 10^20 [l_n - l_n(1-exp(-1))] = 10^20 l_n exp(-1).
代入 l_n=10^-4 cm：net flux = 10^16/e = 3.6788e15 cm^-2 s^-1。
电流密度大小为 |q| times flux = 1.6e-19 * 3.6788e15 = 5.886e-4 A/cm^2 = 0.5886 mA/cm^2，四舍五入为 0.59 mA/cm^2。

method.method_draft: First describe the image: the generation and recombination profiles are mirror-symmetric around x=0, both nonzero only in the central interval -l_n to +l_n, with G a flat 10^20 rectangle and R an exponential peak 10^20 exp(-|x|/l_n). From the text take the steady-state, zero-field condition, the zero excess-carrier boundary positions at ±2l_n, l_n=10^-4 cm, and |q|=1.6×10^-19 C. Consider the whole semiconductor between -2l_n and +2l_n as a control volume. The total net electron production is the graphical area between G and R over -l_n to +l_n. Because the structure and rates are symmetric, half of this net electron production leaves through x=+2l_n. Thus compute the right-side flux as one half of 2∫_0^{l_n}10^20[1-exp(-x/l_n)]dx = 10^20l_n/e, then multiply by |q| and convert to mA/cm², giving about 0.59.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：附图中上半部分给出 p 型半导体区域及光生载流子产生率随 x 的分布。横轴标出 -2ln、-ln、0、ln、2ln。光产生率 G 在 -ln 到 +ln 之间为矩形平台，高度为 10^20 cm^-3/s；在该区间外到 ±2ln 为 0。下半部分给出过剩少数载流子复合率 R 的分布，图中标注 R = 10^20 exp(-|x|/ln)，曲线关于 x=0 对称，在中心处最大，并且只在 -ln 到 +ln 的中心区域内非零，外侧为 0。

推理：题目给出稳态、零电场、低注入条件，且过剩少数载流子密度在 x = ±2ln 为 0。因此可把 -2ln 到 +2ln 整个区域作为控制体。稳态下，光生电子产生率与复合率的差值所对应的净产生电子数，必须通过两端扩散流出。由于图像中 G 和 R 都关于 x=0 对称，左右两端流出的电子通量相等，所以从 x = +2ln 流出的电子通量等于总净产生率面积的一半。

净产生率只在 -ln 到 +ln 内贡献：G - R = 10^20[1 - exp(-|x|/ln)]。利用对称性，总净产生率面积为 2∫_0^ln 10^20[1 - exp(-x/ln)] dx。因此右端电子通量为其一半，即 ∫_0^ln 10^20[1 - exp(-x/ln)] dx。

计算积分：∫_0^ln [1 - exp(-x/ln)] dx = ln - ln(1 - e^-1) = ln/e。因此右端电子通量 = 10^20 ln/e。代入 ln = 10^-4 cm，得到电子通量 = 10^16/e cm^-2 s^-1。

电流密度幅值 = |q| × 电子通量 = 1.6×10^-19 × 10^16/e A/cm² = 5.886×10^-4 A/cm² = 0.5886 mA/cm²。四舍五入到两位小数为 0.59 mA/cm²。

solver_metadata.cot_raw:
图像描述：附图中上半部分给出 p 型半导体区域及光生载流子产生率随 x 的分布。横轴标出 -2ln、-ln、0、ln、2ln。光产生率 G 在 -ln 到 +ln 之间为矩形平台，高度为 10^20 cm^-3/s；在该区间外到 ±2ln 为 0。下半部分给出过剩少数载流子复合率 R 的分布，图中标注 R = 10^20 exp(-|x|/ln)，曲线关于 x=0 对称，在中心处最大，并且只在 -ln 到 +ln 的中心区域内非零，外侧为 0。

推理：题目给出稳态、零电场、低注入条件，且过剩少数载流子密度在 x = ±2ln 为 0。因此可把 -2ln 到 +2ln 整个区域作为控制体。稳态下，光生电子产生率与复合率的差值所对应的净产生电子数，必须通过两端扩散流出。由于图像中 G 和 R 都关于 x=0 对称，左右两端流出的电子通量相等，所以从 x = +2ln 流出的电子通量等于总净产生率面积的一半。

净产生率只在 -ln 到 +ln 内贡献：G - R = 10^20[1 - exp(-|x|/ln)]。利用对称性，总净产生率面积为 2∫_0^ln 10^20[1 - exp(-x/ln)] dx。因此右端电子通量为其一半，即 ∫_0^ln 10^20[1 - exp(-x/ln)] dx。

计算积分：∫_0^ln [1 - exp(-x/ln)] dx = ln - ln(1 - e^-1) = ln/e。因此右端电子通量 = 10^20 ln/e。代入 ln = 10^-4 cm，得到电子通量 = 10^16/e cm^-2 s^-1。

电流密度幅值 = |q| × 电子通量 = 1.6×10^-19 × 10^16/e A/cm² = 5.886×10^-4 A/cm² = 0.5886 mA/cm²。四舍五入到两位小数为 0.59 mA/cm²。

raw_record.original_question: A p-type semiconductor with zero electric field is under illumination (low-level injection) in steady-state condition. Excess minority carrier density is zero at \(x = \pm 2l_n\), where \(l_n = 10^{-4}\,\text{cm}\) is the diffusion length of electrons. Assume electronic charge \(q = -1.6 \times 10^{-19}\,\text{C}\). The profiles of the photo-generation rate of carriers and the recombination rate of excess minority carriers (R) are shown. Under these conditions, the magnitude of the current density due to the photo-generated electrons at \(x = +2l_n\) is ________ mA/cm² (rounded off to two decimal places).
raw_record.final_cot:
Image description: The upper half of the attached figure shows the photogenerated carrier generation rate G(x): it is a rectangular plateau between x=-l_n and x=+l_n, with a value of 10^20 cm^-3 s^-1; it is 0 in the regions x<-l_n and x>+l_n, including being 0 from +l_n to +2l_n. The lower half shows the excess minority carrier recombination rate R(x): in the central region it changes according to R=10^20 exp(-|x|/l_n), symmetric about x=0; it is 0 in the interval from +l_n to +2l_n.

Reasoning: The problem gives l_n=10^-4 cm and electron charge q=-1.6e-19 C, and asks for the magnitude of the photogenerated electron current density at x=+2l_n. Since G and R are symmetric about x=0, the electron current at the center is zero, namely J_n(0)=0. Under steady state and zero electric field, integrating the minority-electron continuity equation from x=0 to x=+2l_n, the electron flux flowing out of the right end equals the integral of the net generation rate in this half-region. In the figure, in the interval from +l_n to +2l_n, G=0 and R=0, so it is only necessary to integrate from 0 to l_n:
net flux = integral_0^l_n [10^20 - 10^20 exp(-x/l_n)] dx = 10^20 [l_n - l_n(1-exp(-1))] = 10^20 l_n exp(-1).
Substituting l_n=10^-4 cm: net flux = 10^16/e = 3.6788e15 cm^-2 s^-1.
The magnitude of the current density is |q| times flux = 1.6e-19 * 3.6788e15 = 5.886e-4 A/cm^2 = 0.5886 mA/cm^2, rounded to 0.59 mA/cm^2.
